user.title: HA Monitoring
user.description: Configure update intervals and exclusion lists by monitoring type.

section_timings.name: ⏱️ Timings & Delays
section_timings.description: Adjust refresh intervals and startup delay.

data_description.scan_interval: Frequency at which the system checks for errors in entities, devices, integrations, add-ons, and checks for pending updates or repairs (default: 2 min).
data_description.traces_scan_interval: Frequency at which the system checks for errors in automation and script traces (default: 30 min).
data_description.offline_timeout: Duration after which a device is considered offline (default: 24 hours).
data_description.startup_delay: Duration during which scanning is bypassed after startup (default: 2 minutes).

section_exclusions_system.name: ⚙️ System Component Exclusions
section_exclusions_system.description: Ignore specific Add-ons, Integrations, or Repairs from scans.

section_exclusions_unavailable.name: 🏷️ Unavailable Entity Exclusions
section_exclusions_unavailable.description: Ignore specific entities or entire domains.

error.invalid_interval: Interval must be at least 5 seconds.
error.invalid_timeout: Inactivity threshold must be at least 1 hour.

abort.already_configured: HA Monitoring integration is already configured.
